name: studio-korean-fashion-blockbuster
image_vibe: Confident premium Korean tailoring against a seamless emerald studio with cinematic magazine polish
image_purpose: Create a high-end fashion campaign or lookbook visual in a horizontal format.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-high-resolution 16:9 full-body studio fashion editorial of an original adult Korean woman lying sideways on the floor.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult Korean woman with refined facial structure, natural realistic skin texture, professional makeup, long straight deep-black hair tied in a high ponytail, and a calm powerful gaze toward camera. She wears a brick-red tailored single-button blazer fitted at the waist, a white shirt with the top button undone, a thin slightly relaxed black tie, and matching slim-fit tailored trousers.
prompt.composition_elements: Full body from head to toe fully inside the 16:9 frame, subject lying sideways on the floor, one elbow supporting the cheek, the other hand on the waist, one leg extended straight and the other bent with foot firmly on the ground, against a seamless infinite emerald-green backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cinematic studio lighting with soft shadows, smooth gradient illumination across the emerald backdrop, sharp subject focus, premium fashion-magazine atmosphere, confident calm power.
prompt.technical_specs: Horizontal 16:9 composition, photorealistic fashion photography, 50mm lens, f/4, high-resolution 8K-style detail, realistic skin, tailoring, hair, and floor texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-high-resolution 16:9 full-body studio fashion editorial of an original adult Korean woman lying sideways on the floor. Give her refined facial structure, natural realistic skin texture, elegant professional makeup, long straight deep-black hair tied in a high ponytail, and a calm powerful gaze toward camera. Dress her in a brick-red tailored single-button blazer fitted at the waist, a white shirt with the top button undone, a thin black tie hanging slightly relaxed, and matching slim-fit tailored trousers. Pose one elbow on the ground supporting her cheek, the other hand on her waist, one leg extended straight and the other bent with the foot firmly touching the ground. Keep the entire subject inside the horizontal frame against a seamless infinite emerald-green backdrop with smooth gradient lighting. Use cinematic soft-shadow studio light, a 50mm lens at f/4, sharp focus, realistic skin, tailoring, hair, and floor texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, premium magazine fashion photography, 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, floating foot, malformed tailoring, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, cropped feet, watermark, text

assets.name: source emerald Korean tailoring portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for the red blazer, black tie, sideways floor pose, high ponytail, emerald backdrop, and cinematic fashion lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult Korean subject, red tailoring, white shirt, black tie, sideways full-body pose, emerald seamless backdrop, and premium editorial mood. Identity and non-essential details may vary.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original adult while retaining the specified Korean fashion styling and pose.
